decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block content, narrows the prize copy to the continuing $900 Small Block prizes, and replaces all amount-dependent payout copy.
Removing Big Block prizes and changing the purchase allocation does not change the deferred Transak provider, wallet-provisioning, payment-method, or mint-destination requirements.
The NFT token serial remains the referral code and its display locations are unaffected by the prize-mechanism and revenue-allocation change.
Winner notifications and the specified confirmation-email contents remain required for the continuing Small Block prizes; the source does not change email delivery behavior.
The one-time email-code authentication and dashboard-access behavior remain valid unchanged.
The removal of Big Block prizes does not alter SIWE, supported wallet users, or protected authentication flows.
Automatic wallet transfer remains the payout mode for the continuing prizes, and this Requirement has no Big-Block-specific claim attribute requiring removal.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows applicable_draws from Small and Big Block to Small Block only.
The existing message-195 MODIFY fully records the $12 founder share, $10 affiliate commission, $8 prize-pool share, and Small-Block-only pool destination.
The existing message-195 MODIFY correctly removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible key while retaining the Small Block counter and unrelated metadata.
The generic rule that active prize tickets follow the NFT remains valid for the continuing Small Block tickets and does not assert that Big Block tickets still exist.
The source explicitly retains the $10 affiliate allocation, so the coded-referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, and payout destination remain unchanged.
